output.reason: The linked issue [ev-36d2a844f18c][ev-068177aa33ae] gives the subject: an earlier change set `automountServiceAccountToken: false` on the `argocd-redis-ha-haproxy` Deployment, and as a result the haproxy pods failed to start in Argo CD HA installs. The fix PR [ev-f374e2b201e0] and its cherry-pick [ev-62b220b96568] turn automount back on (tested with automount true), because without it the pods go into a crash loop backoff. The changed-files lists [ev-9d296f213a2f][ev-cdd13648bc77] show the change touches only the HA manifests and the redis-ha chart values. That limits who is exposed to environments installed from the upstream HA manifests. Together this gives the subject (field and resource), the change (false→true), who is exposed (HA install) and the consequence (with false, the haproxy pods crash-loop).
